Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
Whether the extra capacity is worth it comes down to your spice collection and cabinet width, rather than a difference in materials or build quality.
Both units use identical heavy-duty steel ball-bearing slides and the same patented Flex-Side bands. The 222x2x11 simply adds a third drawer, giving you 50% more storage capacity (holding up to 30 full-size jars versus 20 in the 22x2x11) for a relatively small step up in price.
